mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 33 degrees with foggy conditions reported near Harriet Park, and we are currently under a New Moon.

In city news, the Verona Recreation Department has published updated standings and schedules for men's, women's, and coed leagues, while also providing details for the upcoming November volleyball season at Sugar Creek Elementary.

There is plenty to do, starting with yoga today at Insight Wellness, followed by a busy Tuesday tomorrow featuring trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
Regarding the weekly police recap, on October 19, officers arrested a 49-year-old local man for operating while suspended after he was stopped and found to have an active arrest warrant.
Enjoy the Georgia Peach flavor today at Culver's, which opens today at 10:00 AM.
